senses.en: a meal eaten around the middle of the day
to eat a meal around midday

ex.en: We ate lunch under a tree beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们在河边的一棵树下吃了午饭。

ex.en: Providing nutritious school lunches can improve children's concentration and support healthier eating habits over time.
ex.zh: 提供营养丰富的学校午餐可以提高儿童的专注力，并帮助他们逐渐养成更健康的饮食习惯。

tip: 泛指吃午餐用have lunch，通常不加冠词。

senses.en: a piece of absorbent cloth used for drying things
to dry someone or something with a towel

ex.en: He wrapped a warm towel around his wet shoulders.
ex.zh: 他把一条温暖的毛巾裹在湿漉漉的肩膀上。

ex.en: Hotels can reduce water consumption by encouraging guests to reuse their towels during their stay.
ex.zh: 酒店可以鼓励住客在入住期间重复使用毛巾，以减少用水量。

tip: 可数名词；paper towel指吸水纸巾，不是布毛巾。

senses.en: Used to emphasise something surprising or unexpected.
Flat, regular, or equal in amount or level.
Divisible by two without leaving a remainder.

ex.en: Everyone joined the dance, even our shy uncle.
ex.zh: 大家都加入了舞蹈，连我们害羞的叔叔也不例外。

ex.en: Even small improvements in public transport can make daily travel easier for people with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 即使公共交通只有小幅改善，也能让行动不便者的日常出行更加轻松。

tip: even if表假设“即使”；even though表事实“尽管”。

senses.en: the Christian festival celebrating Jesus's birth, or the surrounding period

ex.en: Our family usually shares a special meal at Christmas.
ex.zh: 我们一家通常在圣诞节一起享用一顿特别的饭菜。

ex.en: During Christmas, increased consumer spending can benefit local shops, although it may also generate additional packaging waste.
ex.zh: 圣诞节期间，消费支出的增加可以使当地商店受益，但也可能产生更多包装废弃物。

tip: 首字母大写；节日期间用at，当天用on Christmas Day。

senses.en: any day from Monday to Friday

ex.en: The swimming pool is quieter on weekday mornings.
ex.zh: 游泳池在工作日的早晨比较安静。

ex.en: Extending library opening hours on weekdays would benefit students who work during the day.
ex.zh: 延长图书馆工作日的开放时间，将有利于白天工作的学生。

tip: 指周一至周五，不保证当天实际上需要上班。

senses.en: to such a degree or extent
used to introduce a result or consequence
used instead of repeating an idea already mentioned

ex.en: The soup was so hot that I had to wait.
ex.zh: 汤太烫了，我只好等一会儿。

ex.en: Public transport is limited in rural areas, so many residents rely on private cars for essential journeys.
ex.zh: 农村地区的公共交通有限，因此许多居民依靠私家车进行必要的出行。

tip: so修饰形容词或副词；such通常修饰名词短语。

senses.zh: 难过的；悲哀的，令人悲痛的；凄惨的，阴郁的（形容颜色）
senses.en: not happy, especially because something unpleasant has happened

ex.en: Sorry to hear the sad news.
ex.zh: 听到这令人伤心的消息我很难过。

senses.en: not wet or containing very little moisture
to remove moisture or become free from moisture
not interesting or entertaining

ex.en: The towels are dry after hanging in the sunshine.
ex.zh: 毛巾在阳光下晾过后已经干了。

ex.en: Long periods of dry weather can damage crops and threaten food security in agricultural communities.
ex.zh: 长期干旱天气会损害农作物，并威胁农业社区的粮食安全。

tip: 形容词比较级drier；名词dryer指烘干设备。

senses.en: an area of land where flowers or vegetables are grown
to grow and care for plants in a garden

ex.en: We picked fresh beans from the garden before lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭前，我们从菜园里摘了新鲜的豆角。

ex.en: Community gardens can strengthen neighbourhood relationships while giving urban residents access to fresh vegetables and green space.
ex.zh: 社区花园既能加强邻里关系，又能让城市居民获得新鲜蔬菜和绿色空间。

tip: 英式garden可指住宅庭院；美式常用yard。

senses.en: Extremely small in size or amount.

ex.en: A tiny frog jumped out of the flower pot.
ex.zh: 一只小小的青蛙从花盆里跳了出来。

ex.en: Even tiny changes in daily habits can reduce household energy consumption over time.
ex.zh: 即使日常习惯的微小改变，长期下来也能减少家庭能源消耗。

tip: 比small语气更强，强调小得惊人。

senses.en: Used to express ability, permission, or possibility.
A metal container for food, drinks, or other substances.
To preserve food by sealing it in cans.

ex.en: I can carry both bags if you open the door.
ex.zh: 你要是把门打开，我就能把两个袋子都提进去。

ex.en: Access to reliable internet can help rural students benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
ex.zh: 稳定的互联网接入能帮助农村学生利用更丰富的教育资源。

tip: 作情态动词后接动词原形，第三人称不加s。

senses.en: A unit of distance equal to approximately 1.61 kilometres.

ex.en: The nearest swimming pool is only a mile away.
ex.zh: 最近的游泳池只有一英里远。

ex.en: Replacing short car journeys with walking even one mile could improve public health and reduce emissions.
ex.zh: 用步行替代短途驾车，哪怕只走一英里，也能改善公众健康并减少排放。

tip: 英里是距离单位；mile可数，复数加s。

senses.en: a country in North America, north of the United States

ex.en: My cousin moved to Canada to study environmental science.
ex.zh: 我的表亲搬到加拿大去学习环境科学。

ex.en: Canada attracts international students through its universities, although living costs vary considerably between cities.
ex.zh: 加拿大的大学吸引着国际学生，不过各城市的生活成本差异很大。

col: study in Canada｜在加拿大学习
tip: 国名首字母大写，前面通常不加the。

senses.en: away from a place or position
away from or no longer touching something
not operating or not working at a particular time

ex.en: The dog ran off when the gate opened.
ex.zh: 门一开，那只狗就跑走了。

ex.en: Keeping unnecessary lights off in public buildings can reduce electricity consumption and lower operating costs.
ex.zh: 关闭公共建筑内不必要的照明可以减少耗电量并降低运营成本。

tip: off强调离开或关闭；of常表示所属，勿混淆。

senses.en: to let someone do something
to make something possible
to provide enough time or resources for something

ex.en: The library allows visitors to borrow five books at once.
ex.zh: 图书馆允许访客一次借五本书。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to balance their professional responsibilities with family commitments more effectively.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排使员工能够更有效地兼顾工作职责与家庭义务。

col: allow someone to do something｜允许某人做某事
allow enough time｜留出足够时间
allow for delays｜考虑到可能的延误
tip: 用allow sb to do；无宾语时可用allow doing。

senses.en: to ask someone to attend something or do something
to request a response or make a reaction likely

ex.en: Let's invite our new neighbours over for dinner.
ex.zh: 我们邀请新邻居过来吃晚饭吧。

ex.en: Local councils should invite residents to discuss proposed changes before making decisions about public spaces.
ex.zh: 地方议会在就公共空间作出决定前，应邀请居民讨论拟议的改动。

col: invite someone to dinner｜邀请某人吃晚饭
invite someone to do something｜邀请某人做某事
tip: invite sb to＋活动；invite sb to do＋动作。

senses.en: an idea or opinion formed in the mind
the process of thinking carefully about something
past tense and past participle of think

ex.en: A sudden thought made me check my coat pocket.
ex.zh: 一个突然冒出的念头让我检查了一下外套口袋。

ex.en: Urban planning requires careful thought about how public spaces can serve people of different ages.
ex.zh: 城市规划需要仔细考虑公共空间如何服务不同年龄的人群。

col: give something some thought｜考虑某事
a sudden thought｜突然冒出的念头
food for thought｜引人深思的事物
tip: 表具体想法时可数；表思考过程时通常不可数。

senses.en: Attractive in appearance, especially describing a man.
Large and impressive in amount.

ex.en: My brother looks handsome in his new blue jacket.
ex.zh: 我哥哥穿着新的蓝色夹克，看起来很英俊。

ex.en: Companies investing in renewable energy may earn handsome profits as demand for cleaner alternatives continues to grow.
ex.zh: 随着对更清洁替代能源的需求持续增长，投资可再生能源的企业可能获得丰厚利润。

tip: 常形容男子英俊；形容利润或报酬时意为丰厚的。

senses.en: Work done to keep a home clean and tidy.

ex.en: We share the housework so nobody spends Sunday cleaning alone.
ex.zh: 我们分担家务，这样就没人需要独自在周日打扫了。

ex.en: Sharing housework fairly allows family members to balance paid employment with responsibilities at home more effectively.
ex.zh: 公平分担家务可以让家庭成员更有效地平衡有偿工作与家庭责任。

tip: 不可数，不能说a housework；做家务用do。

senses.en: Used when I am both the person acting and receiving.
Used to emphasize that I personally do something.

ex.en: I made myself a sandwich before the walk.
ex.zh: 散步前，我给自己做了个三明治。

ex.en: By volunteering at a community garden, I taught myself practical skills that formal education rarely provides.
ex.zh: 通过在社区花园做志愿者，我自学了正规教育很少传授的实用技能。

col: not feel myself｜感觉不在状态
tip: by myself表示独自或独立；不能用myself代替主语I。

senses.en: The fourth month of the year.

ex.en: We are moving into our new flat in April.
ex.zh: 我们将在四月搬进新公寓。

ex.en: The community garden will open in April, giving local residents more opportunities to grow their own vegetables.
ex.zh: 社区菜园将于四月开放，让当地居民有更多机会自己种菜。

tip: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

senses.en: A thin rubber bag filled with air or gas.
A large gas-filled bag carrying people in a basket.

ex.en: A yellow balloon floated above the birthday cake.
ex.zh: 一只黄色气球飘在生日蛋糕上方。

ex.en: Releasing balloons outdoors can harm wildlife when the rubber fragments fall into rivers and oceans.
ex.zh: 在户外放飞气球可能危害野生动物，因为橡胶碎片会落入河流和海洋。

tip: blow up a balloon指吹气球，不是炸毁气球。

senses.en: The space above the earth where clouds and stars appear.

ex.en: The sky turned orange as we walked home.
ex.zh: 我们步行回家时，天空变成了橙色。

ex.en: Light pollution prevents many urban residents from seeing stars clearly in the night sky.
ex.zh: 光污染使许多城市居民无法清楚地看到夜空中的星星。

tip: 通常用the sky；skies常用于描述天气或某地天空。

senses.en: severe weather with strong winds and rain, snow, or thunder
to move somewhere angrily and forcefully
a sudden wave of strong public anger or criticism

ex.en: We stayed indoors while the storm shook the windows.
ex.zh: 暴风雨震得窗户直响，我们一直待在屋里。

ex.en: Coastal communities need stronger flood defences to protect homes and essential services during severe storms.
ex.zh: 沿海社区需要更坚固的防洪设施，以在强风暴期间保护住房和基本公共服务。

col: a storm of protest｜抗议浪潮
storm out of the room｜怒气冲冲地走出房间
tip: storm out表示愤然离开，不是风暴向外移动。

senses.en: a small, flat, crisp baked food, often sweet
a small, soft bread roll raised without yeast

ex.en: She dipped a biscuit into her warm tea.
ex.zh: 她把一块饼干浸进温热的茶里。

ex.en: Replacing sugary biscuits with fresh fruit can help children develop healthier eating habits over time.
ex.zh: 用新鲜水果代替高糖饼干，可以帮助儿童逐渐养成更健康的饮食习惯。

col: a packet of biscuits｜一包饼干
tip: 英式biscuit通常对应美式cookie；美式另指松软面包。

senses.en: Towards or in a lower place or position.
Along something, or from a higher to a lower point.
Feeling unhappy or discouraged.

ex.en: The cat jumped down from the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 猫从厨房的桌子上跳了下来。

ex.en: As housing costs go up, the amount young adults can save often goes down.
ex.zh: 随着住房成本上涨，年轻人能存下的钱往往会减少。

tip: down后接名词可作介词；feel down表示心情低落。

senses.en: Relating to Asia or its people.
A person from Asia or with family origins there.

ex.en: The museum displays pottery from several different Asian countries.
ex.zh: 这家博物馆展出了多个亚洲国家的陶器。

ex.en: Many Asian cities are expanding public transport networks to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 许多亚洲城市正扩建公共交通网络，以缓解交通拥堵并改善城市空气质量。

tip: 首字母须大写；Asia是洲名，Asian可作形容词。

senses.en: a written statement of money owed for goods or services
a proposed law being considered by a lawmaking body
a piece of paper money, especially in American English

ex.en: We asked for the bill after finishing our lunch.
ex.zh: 吃完午饭后，我们请服务员拿来账单。

ex.en: The proposed bill would require companies to disclose more information about their impact on the environment.
ex.zh: 这项拟议法案将要求企业披露更多有关其环境影响的信息。

col: a dollar bill｜一张美元钞票
tip: bill是待审议的法案；通过并生效后才成为法律。

senses.en: get pleasure from an activity or experience
have something good, such as a right or advantage

ex.en: We enjoy walking beside the river after dinner.
ex.zh: 我们喜欢晚饭后在河边散步。

ex.en: Residents enjoy better health when their neighbourhoods provide safe walking routes and accessible green spaces.
ex.zh: 社区提供安全的步行路线和便利的绿地时，居民的健康状况会更好。

tip: 接动词时用-ing形式，不用to do。

senses.en: The organ that pumps blood around the body.
The part of someone associated with feelings and love.
The central or most important part of something.

ex.en: My heart beats faster when I run uphill.
ex.zh: 我跑上坡时，心跳会加快。

ex.en: Regular physical activity strengthens the heart and can reduce the risk of serious illness.
ex.zh: 经常运动能增强心脏功能，并降低患严重疾病的风险。

col: at the heart of｜处于……的核心
tip: by heart表示熟记；lose heart表示灰心。

senses.en: the direction opposite north
in, towards, or facing the south
towards or in the south

ex.en: Our balcony faces south and gets plenty of sunshine.
ex.zh: 我们的阳台朝南，阳光很充足。

ex.en: Many families move to the south because its warmer climate allows more outdoor activities throughout the year.
ex.zh: 许多家庭搬到南方，因为那里气候更温暖，全年都能进行更多户外活动。

tip: 南部用in the south；向南用go south，不加to。

senses.en: full of energy, activity, or excitement
interesting and engaging, with enthusiastic activity or discussion

ex.en: The lively puppy chased a ball around the garden.
ex.zh: 那只活泼的小狗在花园里追着球跑。

ex.en: Lively classroom discussions can encourage students to consider different perspectives and develop critical thinking skills.
ex.zh: 热烈的课堂讨论能鼓励学生考虑不同观点，并培养批判性思维能力。

col: lively imagination｜丰富活跃的想象力
tip: 虽以-ly结尾，却是形容词，不是副词。

senses.en: Happening or moving very quickly.
A fast, turbulent stretch of river, usually called rapids.

ex.en: Her rapid recovery surprised everyone in the family.
ex.zh: 她恢复得如此迅速，让全家人都感到惊讶。

ex.en: Rapid urban growth often places considerable pressure on public transport, housing, and essential services.
ex.zh: 城市的快速发展往往给公共交通、住房和基本服务带来相当大的压力。

tip: rapid常修饰变化或增长；急流通常用rapids。

senses.en: A small amphibian with long back legs for jumping.

ex.en: A green frog jumped from the stone into our pond.
ex.zh: 一只绿色的青蛙从石头上跳进了我们的池塘。

ex.en: Declining frog populations can indicate environmental damage because these animals are sensitive to changes in water quality.
ex.zh: 青蛙数量下降可能表明环境遭到破坏，因为它们对水质变化十分敏感。

tip: 可数名词，复数为frogs；toad指蟾蜍。

senses.en: The power to direct or limit someone or something.
To direct, manage, or limit someone or something.
A device used to operate a machine or vehicle.

ex.en: Keep control of the kite by holding the string firmly.
ex.zh: 抓紧风筝线，控制好风筝。

ex.en: Stricter control of industrial emissions could improve air quality and reduce health risks in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 更严格地控制工业排放可以改善空气质量，并降低人口密集城市的健康风险。

tip: 过去式controlled、现在分词controlling均双写l。

senses.en: pain in a tooth or the surrounding area

ex.en: My toothache kept me awake for most of the night.
ex.zh: 牙痛让我大半夜都没睡着。

ex.en: Affordable dental services allow people with toothache to seek treatment before more serious problems develop.
ex.zh: 价格可负担的牙科服务让牙痛患者能在问题恶化前就医。

tip: 英式常说have toothache，美式常说have a toothache。

senses.en: Quick to learn, understand, or find solutions.
Showing skill or an original way of solving a problem.

ex.en: That clever child fixed the puzzle before lunch.
ex.zh: 那个聪明的孩子午饭前就解开了这道谜题。

ex.en: Clever design can make small urban apartments feel spacious without increasing their environmental impact.
ex.zh: 巧妙的设计可以让城市小公寓显得宽敞，同时不增加其环境影响。

tip: 比较级cleverer，最高级cleverest。

senses.en: to move something higher or increase its amount or level
to collect money for a particular purpose
to care for children or animals as they grow

ex.en: Please raise your hand if you need another pencil.
ex.zh: 如果你还需要一支铅笔，请举手。

ex.en: Community events can raise funds for conservation projects while helping residents understand local environmental challenges.
ex.zh: 社区活动可以为自然保护项目筹集资金，同时帮助居民了解当地的环境问题。

tip: raise是及物动词，后接宾语；rise表示自身上升。

senses.en: To guide people or cause something to happen
The position of being ahead of others
A soft, heavy, grey metal that can be poisonous

ex.en: Our guide led us safely through the forest.
ex.zh: 向导带着我们安全地穿过了森林。

ex.en: Poor access to public transport can lead to greater dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通不便可能导致人们更加依赖私家车。

tip: 铅读/led/；动词读/liːd/，过去式和过去分词为led。

senses.en: an agreement between people or organisations, especially in business
to take action about a problem, usually with with
to give cards or other things to several people

ex.en: We got a good deal on our new sofa.
ex.zh: 我们以很划算的价格买到了新沙发。

ex.en: Governments must deal with housing shortages by supporting affordable construction and improving public transport links.
ex.zh: 政府必须通过支持可负担住房建设和改善公共交通连接来应对住房短缺。

col: deal with a problem｜处理问题
tip: deal with表示处理；a great deal of后接不可数名词。

senses.en: An object or collection of objects wrapped or boxed together.
A set of services or measures offered together.
To put something into a container for sale or transport.

ex.en: A small package arrived at our door this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，一个小包裹送到了我们家门口。

ex.en: The government introduced a support package to help small businesses invest in cleaner production methods.
ex.zh: 政府推出了一揽子扶持措施，帮助小企业投资更清洁的生产方式。

col: a support package｜一揽子扶持措施
tip: 指邮寄的包裹时，英式英语也常用parcel。

senses.en: used to ask for information or for someone’s opinion

ex.en: What are you doing?
ex.zh: 你在做什么？

ex.en: What subjects did you enjoy most?
ex.zh: 你最喜欢什么学科？

senses.en: A farm animal with a broad snout and short legs.

ex.en: A pink pig was sleeping beside the wooden fence.
ex.zh: 一头粉色的猪正睡在木栅栏旁。

ex.en: Farmers can improve animal welfare by giving pigs enough space to move freely and explore.
ex.zh: 农民可以给猪足够的自由活动和探索空间，以改善动物福利。

tip: pig指动物；作为食物的猪肉通常用pork。

senses.en: the body part containing the brain, eyes, and mouth
the person in charge of a group or organisation
to move or travel in a particular direction

ex.en: She shook her head when I offered more soup.
ex.zh: 我问她要不要再来点汤，她摇了摇头。

ex.en: Cyclists should wear suitable helmets to reduce the risk of head injuries when travelling on busy roads.
ex.zh: 骑车人在繁忙道路上行驶时应佩戴合适的头盔，以降低头部受伤的风险。

tip: head for＋地点表示“朝某地去”。

senses.en: knowledge or skill gained by doing things
something that happens to you or that you do
to have something happen to you or feel something

ex.en: My sister has years of experience repairing old bicycles.
ex.zh: 我姐姐有多年修理旧自行车的经验。

ex.en: Work experience can help graduates develop practical skills that employers value alongside academic qualifications.
ex.zh: 工作经验能帮助毕业生培养实践技能，而雇主不仅重视学历，也看重这些技能。

col: a rewarding experience｜有收获的经历
tip: 表“经验”不可数；表具体“经历”可数。

senses.en: make someone face an unpleasant consequence for doing wrong

ex.en: The referee punished the player for breaking the rules.
ex.zh: 裁判因那名球员违反规则而对其作出处罚。

ex.en: Schools should explain why behaviour is unacceptable rather than simply punish students without offering guidance.
ex.zh: 学校应解释为何某种行为不可接受，而不是只惩罚学生却不给予引导。

col: punish someone for something｜因某事惩罚某人
tip: punish sb for sth表示因某事惩罚某人。

senses.en: to grow or make something stronger, larger, or more advanced
to create a new product, method, or idea
to begin to have a condition, problem, or feeling

ex.en: Children develop confidence when they try new activities.
ex.zh: 孩子们尝试新活动时会逐渐建立自信。

ex.en: Governments should fund research to develop affordable technologies that address water shortages in rural communities.
ex.zh: 政府应资助研究，开发价格可负担的技术，以解决农村社区的缺水问题。

tip: 可及物也可不及物：develop skills；skills develop。

senses.en: The yearly anniversary of the day someone was born.

ex.en: My sister baked a lemon cake for my birthday.
ex.zh: 姐姐为我的生日烤了一个柠檬蛋糕。

ex.en: Although birthday celebrations vary across cultures, they often provide opportunities for families to spend time together.
ex.zh: 虽然不同文化中的生日庆祝方式各异，但它们往往能让家人有机会相聚。

tip: 在某人生日当天用on，不用in或at。

senses.en: Someone who studies the natural world through research and experiments

ex.en: The scientist examined a drop of water under the microscope.
ex.zh: 这位科学家用显微镜观察了一滴水。

ex.en: Scientists are developing more efficient batteries to support the transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy.
ex.zh: 科学家正在研发效率更高的电池，以支持从化石燃料向可再生能源的转型。

tip: scientist指人，science指科学，scientific是形容词。

senses.en: to be unsuccessful or not do something required
to not pass a test, or give an unsuccessful grade
to stop working properly or become weaker

ex.en: The cake failed to rise despite an extra egg.
ex.zh: 尽管多加了一个鸡蛋，蛋糕还是没发起来。

ex.en: Recycling programmes often fail when local authorities do not provide clear guidance or convenient collection services.
ex.zh: 地方政府若不提供清晰指导或便捷的收集服务，回收计划往往会失败。

col: fail to do something｜未能做某事
fail to meet expectations｜未达到预期
tip: fail to do表示未能做；fail an exam表示考试不及格。

senses.en: To move backwards and forwards or in a curved path.
A hanging seat that moves backwards and forwards.
A noticeable change in an opinion, mood, or situation.

ex.en: Her bag swung gently as she walked down the street.
ex.zh: 她走在街上，包随着步伐轻轻摆动。

ex.en: A sharp swing in public opinion can encourage governments to reconsider policies that previously enjoyed widespread support.
ex.zh: 公众意见的急剧转变可能促使政府重新审视此前获得广泛支持的政策。

col: swing back and forth｜来回摆动
a swing in public opinion｜舆论转变
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为swung；不是swinged。

senses.en: Every person in a group, or all people.

ex.en: Everyone brought a dish to share at the picnic.
ex.zh: 每个人都带了一道菜，在野餐时一起分享。

ex.en: Public libraries should ensure that everyone can access reliable information, regardless of income or educational background.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆应确保每个人都能获取可靠信息，不论收入或教育背景如何。

tip: everyone接单数谓语；every one强调逐个。

ex.en: The table’s about this high and this wide.
ex.zh: 那桌子大约有这么高，这么宽。

ex.en: You need to cut about this much off the end of the pipe.
ex.zh: 你要从管子头上切下大约这么多。

senses.en: A white liquid female mammals produce to feed their young.
Take milk from an animal, especially a cow.

ex.en: I poured some cold milk over my cereal.
ex.zh: 我往麦片上倒了些冷牛奶。

ex.en: Milk provides calcium and protein, although people with certain dietary needs may choose suitable alternatives.
ex.zh: 牛奶提供钙和蛋白质，但有特殊饮食需求的人可以选择合适的替代品。

col: a glass of milk｜一杯牛奶
tip: milk通常不可数；说a glass of milk，不说a milk。

senses.en: Use more of something than necessary or without useful results.
Unwanted material left after something has been used or made.
An unnecessary or unproductive use of time, money, or resources.

ex.en: Don't waste water by leaving the tap running.
ex.zh: 别让水龙头一直开着，白白浪费水。

ex.en: Reducing household waste requires both convenient recycling facilities and greater public awareness of responsible consumption.
ex.zh: 减少生活垃圾既需要便利的回收设施，也需要提高公众的负责任消费意识。

col: a waste of money｜浪费金钱
tip: 用waste time doing sth，通常不用to do。

senses.en: Not present where someone is expected to be.
Not existing or found in a particular place or situation.

ex.en: Lina was absent from class because she felt ill.
ex.zh: 莉娜因身体不适没有来上课。

ex.en: Students who are frequently absent from school may require additional support to keep up with their classmates.
ex.zh: 经常缺课的学生可能需要额外帮助，才能跟上同学的学习进度。

tip: 表示缺席某场合用absent from，不用absent in。

senses.en: On the day after today.
The day after today, or the future more generally.

ex.en: We are meeting at the swimming pool tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 我们明天早上在游泳池见面。

ex.en: The environmental decisions made today will shape the world that the children of tomorrow inherit.
ex.zh: 今天作出的环境决策将塑造未来孩子们继承的世界。

tip: tomorrow前通常不加on；明早是tomorrow morning。

senses.en: The worldwide network connecting computers and other devices.

ex.en: The internet stopped working halfway through our video call.
ex.zh: 我们视频通话进行到一半时断网了。

ex.en: Reliable internet access enables rural students to use educational resources that may be unavailable locally.
ex.zh: 可靠的互联网接入让农村学生能够使用当地可能缺乏的教育资源。

tip: 通常说 the internet；作定语时不用 the。

senses.en: A small brush used for cleaning your teeth.

ex.en: I packed my toothbrush in the side pocket.
ex.zh: 我把牙刷装进了侧面的口袋。

ex.en: Replacing a worn toothbrush regularly helps maintain oral hygiene by ensuring that teeth are cleaned effectively.
ex.zh: 定期更换磨损的牙刷有助于确保牙齿得到有效清洁，从而保持口腔卫生。

tip: 复数是toothbrushes，不是teethbrushes。

senses.en: close to a place, time, or state
at or towards a short distance away in space or time
not far away in distance or time

ex.en: We found a quiet café near the station.
ex.zh: 我们在车站附近找到了一家安静的咖啡馆。

ex.en: Building affordable housing near public transport can reduce commuting costs and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 在公共交通设施附近建设经济适用住房，可以降低通勤成本并增加就业机会。

col: in the near future｜在不久的将来
tip: near可直接接地点；nearly通常表示“几乎”。

senses.en: The whole physical structure of a person or animal.
An organized group with a particular purpose.
The main or central part of something.

ex.en: My whole body aches after yesterday's long walk.
ex.zh: 昨天走了很长一段路，现在我全身酸痛。

ex.en: An independent body should monitor water quality and publish its findings for the public.
ex.zh: 应由一个独立机构监测水质，并向公众公布调查结果。

col: a body of evidence｜一系列证据
the body of an essay｜文章正文
tip: body可指机构；文章的body指正文部分。

senses.en: a very young child or animal
very young, or intended for babies
treat someone as helpless or needing excessive care

ex.en: The baby fell asleep while her father sang softly.
ex.zh: 爸爸轻声唱歌时，宝宝睡着了。

ex.en: Affordable childcare helps parents of young babies return to work without placing excessive pressure on family finances.
ex.zh: 负担得起的托育服务有助于婴儿的父母重返工作岗位，而不会给家庭财务带来过大压力。

tip: 复数为babies；baby作动词常含“过度照顾”之意。

senses.en: the inside surface at the top of a room
the highest amount or level that is allowed

ex.en: A small spider was crawling across the ceiling.
ex.zh: 一只小蜘蛛正爬过天花板。

ex.en: A ceiling on annual rent increases could protect tenants, although it might discourage investment in housing.
ex.zh: 限制年度租金涨幅可以保护租户，但也可能抑制住房投资。

col: set a ceiling on｜为……设定上限
tip: ceiling是室内天花板；roof是建筑外部的屋顶。

senses.en: Telling the truth and not cheating or stealing.
Expressing what you really think or feel.

ex.en: The honest cashier returned the money I had overpaid.
ex.zh: 那位诚实的收银员退还了我多付的钱。

ex.en: Honest communication between teachers and parents can help schools address students' difficulties before they become serious.
ex.zh: 教师与家长之间坦诚的沟通能帮助学校在学生的问题变得严重之前加以解决。

tip: h不发音，因此说an honest person。

senses.en: The central part, point, or position of something
Located between other things or between the beginning and end

ex.en: Someone left a suitcase in the middle of the hallway.
ex.zh: 有人把一个行李箱放在了走廊正中央。

ex.en: Housing costs often force essential workers to live far from the middle of the cities they serve.
ex.zh: 住房成本常常迫使提供必要服务的工作者住在远离其服务城市中心的地方。

tip: 名词常用the middle of；形容词直接修饰名词。

senses.en: Moving or staying at a distance from someone or something.
Not at home or at the usual place.

ex.en: The little bird flew away when I opened the window.
ex.zh: 我打开窗户时，小鸟飞走了。

ex.en: Moving away from crowded cities can improve wellbeing, but may reduce access to employment.
ex.zh: 搬离拥挤的城市可能改善身心健康，但也可能减少就业机会。

tip: away是副词；表示“远离某处”用away from。

senses.en: The idea that a word, action, or message communicates.
The importance or purpose that makes something worthwhile.

ex.en: Could you explain the meaning of this unusual word?
ex.zh: 你能解释一下这个不常见的词是什么意思吗？

ex.en: Volunteering can give people a sense of meaning while strengthening connections within their local communities.
ex.zh: 志愿服务既能让人感到生活有意义，也能加强当地社区内部的联系。

col: the meaning of a word｜词义
give meaning to life｜赋予生活意义
tip: 问词义用the meaning of；不要与opinion混淆。

senses.en: The part of the day between afternoon and bedtime.

ex.en: We spent the evening cooking and listening to music.
ex.zh: 我们做饭、听音乐，度过了这个晚上。

ex.en: Evening classes allow working adults to gain new qualifications without giving up their current employment.
ex.zh: 晚间课程让在职成年人无需辞去现有工作，也能获得新的资格证书。

tip: 泛指晚上用in the evening；this evening前不加介词。

senses.en: Very pleasing to see, hear, or experience.

ex.en: The garden looks beautiful after the spring rain.
ex.zh: 春雨过后，花园看起来很美。

ex.en: Protecting beautiful natural landscapes can attract visitors while preserving valuable habitats for future generations.
ex.zh: 保护美丽的自然景观既能吸引游客，又能为后代保留宝贵的栖息地。

tip: 可修饰景色、声音等；比较级用more beautiful。

senses.en: Something given freely to another person
A natural ability to do something well
To give something to someone as a present

ex.en: My sister wrapped the gift in bright yellow paper.
ex.zh: 姐姐用鲜黄色的纸把礼物包了起来。

ex.en: Schools should nurture each child's gift rather than judge everyone by the same narrow standards.
ex.zh: 学校应培养每个孩子的天赋，而不是用同一套狭隘的标准评判所有人。

col: a gift for languages｜语言天赋
tip: 表示天赋时常用 a gift for，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: Meat from a pig, used as food.

ex.en: We cooked the pork slowly with apples and onions.
ex.zh: 我们把猪肉和苹果、洋葱一起慢炖。

ex.en: Clear food labelling helps consumers identify products containing pork and make choices that suit their dietary requirements.
ex.zh: 清晰的食品标签有助于消费者识别含猪肉的产品，并作出符合自身饮食要求的选择。

tip: pork是不可数名词，指肉；活猪用pig。

senses.en: make an effort to do something
use or do something to see whether it works
an attempt to do something

ex.en: I'll try to fix the lamp before dinner.
ex.zh: 我会试着在晚饭前把灯修好。

ex.en: Schools should try different teaching methods to meet the needs of students with varying abilities.
ex.zh: 学校应尝试不同的教学方法，以满足能力各异的学生的需求。

col: try to do something｜努力做某事
tip: try to do强调努力；try doing强调试试办法。

senses.en: A primate that usually has a tail and climbs trees.

ex.en: A little monkey swung between branches above our heads.
ex.zh: 一只小猴子在我们头顶的树枝间荡来荡去。

ex.en: Protecting tropical forests helps preserve monkey populations and the complex ecosystems on which they depend.
ex.zh: 保护热带森林有助于保护猴类种群及其赖以生存的复杂生态系统。

col: a troop of monkeys｜一群猴子
tip: monkey通常有尾巴；ape指猿类，通常无尾。

senses.en: Known by many people.

ex.en: This village is famous for its delicious apple pies.
ex.zh: 这个村庄以美味的苹果派闻名。

ex.en: Famous landmarks attract international visitors, but tourism revenue should also support the communities surrounding them.
ex.zh: 著名地标吸引着国际游客，但旅游收入也应惠及周边社区。

tip: famous for接出名的原因，famous as接身份。

senses.en: Having the colour of grass and most leaves.
Causing little harm to the environment.
The colour of grass and most leaves.

ex.en: She wore a green jacket to match her shoes.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件绿色夹克来搭配鞋子。

ex.en: Governments can encourage green transport by improving public services and building safer routes for cyclists.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过改善公共服务和修建更安全的自行车道来鼓励绿色出行。

col: go green｜采取环保生活方式
tip: 除颜色外，green常表示环保；形容人还可指缺乏经验。

senses.en: a long, thin mark on a surface
people or things arranged one behind or beside another
a route or connection for transport or communication

ex.en: Draw a straight line across the page with your ruler.
ex.zh: 用尺子在纸上画一条直线。

ex.en: Extending the railway line could connect rural communities with employment opportunities in nearby cities.
ex.zh: 延长铁路线可以让农村社区的居民获得附近城市的就业机会。

tip: 排队在美式英语中常用stand in line，英式常用queue。

senses.en: A building or group of buildings where goods are manufactured.

ex.en: My aunt works at a factory that makes bicycles.
ex.zh: 我姑姑在一家生产自行车的工厂工作。

ex.en: Governments should require factory owners to reduce harmful emissions without compromising the safety and livelihoods of their workers.
ex.zh: 政府应要求工厂主减少有害排放，同时不损害工人的安全和生计。

tip: 复数为factories；指制造产品的场所。

senses.en: the day after Friday and before Sunday

ex.en: We usually buy fresh vegetables at the market on Saturday.
ex.zh: 我们通常星期六去市场买新鲜蔬菜。

ex.en: Opening public libraries on Saturday allows more working parents to participate in educational activities with their children.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆在星期六开放，让更多上班的家长能与孩子一起参加教育活动。

tip: 首字母大写；on Saturday，但this Saturday前不用on。

senses.en: problems or difficulties that cause worry or inconvenience
to cause someone worry or ask them for help

ex.en: We had trouble opening the stiff kitchen window.
ex.zh: 厨房的窗户很紧，我们费了好大劲才打开。

ex.en: Many older adults have trouble accessing public services that are available only through digital platforms.
ex.zh: 许多老年人难以使用那些仅通过数字平台提供的公共服务。

col: have trouble doing something｜做某事有困难
take the trouble to do something｜费心做某事
tip: 表示做某事有困难，用have trouble doing。

senses.en: taking care to avoid danger, damage, or mistakes
giving close attention to details

ex.en: Be careful with that bowl; it belonged to Grandma.
ex.zh: 小心拿那个碗，那是奶奶以前用的。

ex.en: Careful planning can help cities expand public transport while keeping construction costs under control.
ex.zh: 周密的规划可以帮助城市扩展公共交通，同时控制建设成本。

tip: be careful with后接物；be careful to后接动词。

senses.en: a vegetable with large leaves forming a firm round head

ex.en: She sliced the cabbage thinly and added it to soup.
ex.zh: 她把卷心菜切成细丝，放进汤里。

ex.en: Locally grown vegetables such as cabbage can support healthier diets while reducing the environmental impact of food transport.
ex.zh: 卷心菜等本地种植的蔬菜有助于改善饮食健康，同时减少食品运输对环境的影响。

col: a head of cabbage｜一颗卷心菜
tip: 整颗可数：a cabbage；作为食材通常不可数。

senses.en: a person or team that wins a competition

senses.zh: 成功的人或事物；受益者
senses.en: someone or something successful or benefiting from a situation

ex.en: The winner lifted her trophy as the crowd cheered.
ex.zh: 获胜者举起奖杯，人群欢呼起来。

ex.en: Consumers may be the main winners when greater competition encourages companies to lower prices and improve services.
ex.zh: 当更激烈的竞争促使企业降价并改善服务时，消费者可能成为主要受益者。

tip: winner 指获胜者；winning 可作形容词修饰队伍。

senses.en: To keep someone or something safe from harm or damage

ex.en: Wear thick gloves to protect your hands from thorns.
ex.zh: 戴上厚手套，保护双手不被刺扎伤。

ex.en: Governments should protect endangered species by preserving natural habitats and restricting activities that threaten their survival.
ex.zh: 政府应通过保护自然栖息地并限制威胁生存的活动，来保护濒危物种。

col: protect from harm｜保护……免受伤害
tip: 常用protect sb/sth from或against，表示免受伤害。

senses.en: free from mistakes and matching the facts
to identify mistakes or change something to make it right
suitable or accepted as proper for a particular situation

ex.en: You were correct about the keys being under the sofa.
ex.zh: 你说钥匙在沙发下面，果然没错。

ex.en: Teachers should help students correct their mistakes rather than simply provide them with the right answers.
ex.zh: 教师应帮助学生纠正错误，而不是仅仅给他们正确答案。

tip: 既是形容词也是动词；correctly才是副词。

senses.en: To desire something or wish for something to happen.
A lack of something needed, especially basic necessities.

ex.en: I want to grow tomatoes on our balcony.
ex.zh: 我想在我们的阳台上种番茄。

ex.en: Many young adults want governments to invest more in affordable housing rather than expensive urban redevelopment projects.
ex.zh: 许多年轻人希望政府更多投资于可负担住房，而不是昂贵的城市重建项目。

col: want to do something｜想做某事
want someone to do something｜想让某人做某事
tip: 用want to do或want sb to do，不用want doing表想做。

senses.en: a period of relaxing without working or being active
to relax or allow someone or something to recover
the people or things that remain

ex.en: Let's have a rest under that shady tree.
ex.zh: 我们在那棵树荫下休息一下吧。

ex.en: Regular periods of rest can help employees maintain concentration and reduce the risk of workplace accidents.
ex.zh: 定期休息有助于员工保持专注，并降低工作场所发生事故的风险。

tip: the rest of后接名词，谓语单复数随所指内容变化。

senses.en: Needing considerable effort or skill to do or understand.
Not easy to please, manage, or deal with.

ex.en: This heavy suitcase is difficult to carry upstairs.
ex.zh: 这个沉重的行李箱很难搬上楼。

ex.en: Many graduates find it difficult to secure stable employment without previous experience in their chosen field.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生发现，如果没有所选领域的工作经验，就很难找到稳定的工作。

col: a difficult customer｜难应付的顾客
tip: 常用find it difficult to do，勿把difficulty当形容词。

senses.en: a pronunciation style associated with a place or social group
emphasis on a syllable, or a mark indicating pronunciation
to give special emphasis or prominence to something

ex.en: Her accent reminds me of my neighbours back home.
ex.zh: 她的口音让我想起家乡的邻居。

ex.en: Teachers should value different accents while helping learners develop clear pronunciation for effective international communication.
ex.zh: 教师应尊重不同口音，同时帮助学习者练就清晰的发音，以便有效开展国际交流。

col: speak with an accent｜说话带口音
tip: accent指发音特点；dialect还涉及词汇和语法。

senses.en: the reflexive form of one27

ex.en: It is only through study that one really begins to know oneself.
ex.zh: 只有通过学习，一个人才能真正了解自己。

senses.en: A hard black or brown material burned to produce heat.

ex.en: The old stove still burns coal during winter.
ex.zh: 这个旧炉子冬天仍然烧煤取暖。

ex.en: Replacing coal with renewable energy can reduce air pollution and lower greenhouse gas emissions from electricity generation.
ex.zh: 用可再生能源替代煤炭，可以减少空气污染并降低发电产生的温室气体排放。

tip: coal指煤，charcoal指木炭；煤通常用作不可数名词。

senses.en: a small, flat piece of metal used as money
to invent a new word or expression

ex.en: A silver coin rolled under the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 一枚银色硬币滚到了厨房桌子下面。

ex.en: As digital payments become more widespread, fewer consumers carry coins for everyday purchases such as bus fares.
ex.zh: 随着数字支付日益普及，随身携带硬币用于公交车费等日常支出的人越来越少。

tip: coin作动词常指创造词语，如coin a term。

senses.en: existing in fact rather than being imagined
genuine rather than copied or artificial
measured after allowing for changes in prices

ex.en: I thought the bird was plastic, but it was real.
ex.zh: 我以为那只鸟是塑料的，没想到是真的。

ex.en: Although average salaries have increased, rising prices mean that many workers have experienced a fall in real income.
ex.zh: 虽然平均工资上涨了，但物价上涨意味着许多劳动者的实际收入有所下降。

tip: real修饰名词；表示“很、真正地”通常用really。

senses.en: Despite the fact that something is true.
Used to introduce a contrasting point, often at sentence end.

ex.en: Though it was raining, we still walked to the bakery.
ex.zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是步行去了面包店。

ex.en: Though online courses offer greater flexibility, many students still benefit from direct interaction with teachers.
ex.zh: 虽然线上课程更加灵活，但许多学生仍能从与教师的直接交流中获益。

tip: 引导让步从句时不与but连用；句末可表“不过”。

senses.en: to separate something into parts or share it among people
to calculate how many times one quantity fits into another
a major difference separating people or groups

ex.en: Let's divide the cake into slices before everyone arrives.
ex.zh: 趁大家还没来，我们先把蛋糕切成小块吧。

ex.en: Unequal access to reliable internet services can deepen the digital divide between urban and rural communities.
ex.zh: 获得可靠互联网服务的机会不均，可能加深城乡社区之间的数字鸿沟。

tip: divide into表示分成；divide by表示除以。

senses.zh: 叶子；（书籍等的）一张；扇页
senses.en: one of the flat green parts of a plant that are joined to its stem or branches
coming immediately after the third in a sequence
one of four equal parts of a whole

ex.en: Our apartment is on the fourth floor, beside the lift.
ex.zh: 我们的公寓在四楼，就在电梯旁边。

ex.en: The fourth stage of the recycling process involves transforming cleaned plastic into material suitable for new products.
ex.zh: 回收流程的第四阶段是将清洗后的塑料转化为适合制造新产品的材料。

tip: 第四是fourth；forth意为向前，注意拼写。

senses.en: medical care given to improve an illness or injury
the way someone behaves towards a person or group
a process that cleans, protects, or changes a substance

ex.en: After treatment, her injured ankle felt much better.
ex.zh: 经过治疗，她受伤的脚踝感觉好多了。

ex.en: Access to affordable medical treatment is essential for reducing health inequalities between wealthy and disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 获得负担得起的医疗服务，对于缩小富裕社区与弱势社区之间的健康差距至关重要。

tip: 泛指治疗通常不可数；指具体疗法时可用a treatment。

senses.en: an ability to do something well, developed through practice

ex.en: Baking good bread takes patience and a little skill.
ex.zh: 烤出好面包需要耐心和一点技巧。

ex.en: Schools should teach practical skills that help young people manage money and communicate effectively.
ex.zh: 学校应教授实用技能，帮助年轻人管理金钱并进行有效沟通。

col: develop a skill｜培养一项技能
skill in doing something｜做某事的技巧
tip: 具体技能可数；泛指熟练程度时常不可数。

senses.en: used when talking about someone who may be male or female, to avoid saying ‘his or her’

ex.en: They talked her round to their position.
ex.zh: 他们说服她同意他们的看法。

senses.en: The possibility that someone or something will be harmed.
Someone or something that may cause harm.

ex.en: Keep away from the edge; there's a danger of falling.
ex.zh: 离边缘远一点，有掉下去的危险。

ex.en: Poorly maintained roads pose a serious danger to cyclists, particularly in areas without dedicated cycling lanes.
ex.zh: 维护不善的道路对骑车人构成严重威胁，尤其是在没有专用自行车道的地区。

col: pose a danger to｜对……构成威胁
tip: in danger指处于危险中；dangerous指会带来危险。
